newsitem.title: USA: Amylin expands pact with J&J.
newsitem.headline: Amylin expands pact with J&J.

text.p: Amylin Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Wednesday Johnson & Johnson has exercised an option to broaden the scope of their existing collaboration on pramlintide, a drug candidate that is in Phase III clinical trials in patients with diabetes who use insulin.
Johnson & Johnson will pay the company $6 million to obtain additional rights for all amylin agonists for the treatment of fuel metabolism disorders, including diabetes.

Amylin Pharmaceuticals has been collaborating with Johnson & Johnson since June 1995 to develop pramlintide, an analog of human amylin, with the aim of improving glucose control for people with diabetes who use insulin.

It has been clearly demonstrated that improved glucose control lowers the risk of degenerative diabetic complications. Amylin Pharmaceuticals is leading the research and development, while Johnson & Johnson is leading the commercialization of pramlintide and any future product candidates.
Regulatory submissions for pramlintide are planned for 1998 in North America and Europe. The companies will share equally in any profits resulting from the commercialization of product candidates.

Amylin is focused on developing novel medicines for treating diabetes and related metabolic disorders. The company has pioneered research of the hormone amylin, which is believed to play an important role in glucose control and is missing or deficient in millions of people with diabetes.
The company is collaborating with Johnson & Johnson to develop pramlintide, a chemical analog of human amylin, with the aim of improving glucose control for people with diabetes who use insulin.

Pramlintide is currently the subject of six, pivotal, Phase III Paradigm clinical studies aimed at demonstrating its ability to improve glucose control when used as an adjunct to insulin therapy in people with diabetes, thereby lowering their risk of degenerative complications.
Found in 1987, Amylin is headquartered in San Diego, California.
